items.desc_now: DSH plugin: idle-chat nudges for opted-in chats plus an authenticated HTTP API that posts a prompt into any chat, on DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x
items.desc_prev: DSH plugin: auto-prompt opted-in chats after an idle window (personalised prompts, per-chat on/off, settings UI) plus a secret-protected HTTP API to prompt any chat from outside.
